rows.text: sets bit `edx` (modulo 32, via `bts`) of dword `+0x44C` of `rcx` and stores the dword back

calls `0017FE30()` and picks the double 0.01666666667 (`009010A0`) when the unsigned result is a multiple of 10, otherwise 0.01668333333 (`00900378`); returns the signed dword result of `00184950()` converted to double and multiplied by the picked value

notes: 001E04F0: the multiple-of-10 test is the reciprocal multiply by 0xCCCCCCCD, shift by 3, times 10 and compare.
